Claim 1 (Currently Amended): An alarm system comprising: a physiological monitor capable of triggering a first alarm in response to an alarm condition; and a station located remotely from the physiological monitor, wherein the station is capable of receiving an input from the physiological monitor and triggering a second alarm in response to the alarm condition, and wherein when the second alarm is not acknowledged within a predetermined time period, the station is capable of sending an output to the physiological monitor to initiate an escalated alarm at the physiological monitor, wherein the escalated alarm is distinct from and more urgent than the first alarm.

Claim 2 (Previously presented): The system of claim 1, wherein the second alarm is capable of being acknowledged by an operator input before expiration of a timer.

Claim 3 (Previously presented): The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an inaudible alarm.

Claim 4 (Previously presented): The system of claim 1, wherein the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm.

Claim 5 (Previously presented): The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm comprises an audible alarm and the escalated alarm comprises an audible alarm that is louder than the first alarm.

Claim 6 (Previously presented): The system of claim 1, wherein the first alarm and the second alarm are triggered substantially simultaneously.

Claim 7 (Previously presented): The system of claim 1, wherein the station located remotely from the physiological monitor is part of a central patient management system.

Claim 16 (Currently Amended): A system comprising: a processor programmed to trigger an alarm in response to an alarm condition and to track escalation of the alarm; a memory capable of storing alarm data associated with the alarm, wherein the alarm data comprises an alarm type, a time that the alarm was triggered, and escalation status; and a display capable of displaying the alarm data, wherein the system is configured to distinguish between initial alarms and escalated alarms based on acknowledgement status.

Claim 17 (Currently Amended): The system of claim 16, wherein the system is part of a physiological monitor or a central management system, and wherein the system is configured to communicate escalation information between the physiological monitor and the central management system.

Claim 18 (Currently Amended): The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about a level of escalation of the alarm, wherein escalation occurs when an alarm is not acknowledged within a specified time interval.

Claim 19 (Currently Amended): The system of claim 16, wherein the alarm data comprises information about an acknowledgement of the alarm and a timestamp of the acknowledgement.

Claim 20 (Currently Amended): The system of claim 16, wherein the processor is programmed to send the alarm data to one or more wireless devices when the alarm reaches a specified escalation level.
